step: B-S16 (R-3, R-5): tests-visual carved. A visual spec whose subject is one unit (LAW §9: every sealed file it reads lies in that unit, and it reads no consumer zone) moves into the unit's __tests__/ slot as *.visual.ts; every other file joins a named module of the workspace by the surface it reads back. The Playwright program is edited first (carve.mjs's program row), so no spec leaves it. These moves carry edges the engine cannot respell, or respells wrong (rebase.mjs); they land as one exact-text row.

the script names its spec by path. The engine respells the token package-relative (`dock/…`), which F-1's command scanner does not read as a path (a token is zone-rooted or a bare file name), so the edge is lost; the row spells it zone-rooted, which F-1 reads and Playwright takes as the same path filter
